map.根据超声心动图积液深度定量分级，结合心包填塞征象评估处理策略: Quantitative grading by echocardiographic effusion depth, combined with cardiac tamponade signs to assess management strategy
map.📖 查看「心包积液(大小)定量器 使用指南」: View the Pericardial Effusion (Size) Quantifier Guide
map.前后方均有，心脏仍居中: Both anterior and posterior, heart still centered
map.IVC增宽无塌陷(>2.1cm，塌陷<50%): Dilated IVC, no collapse (>2.1 cm, collapse <50%)
map.提示：积液增长速度比绝对量更重要——少量积液快速增加可致填塞，大量慢性积液可无症: Note: The rate of effusion accumulation matters more than absolute volume - a small effusion that grows rapidly can cause tamponade, while a large chronic effusion may be asymptomatic. Localized effusions need multi-plane assessment. Tamponade is an emergency; once confirmed, urgent pericardiocentesis drainage is required. For clinical reference only.
map.积液量分级：超声按舒张期液性暗区最大宽度，少量（<10 mm）、中量（10–20: Volume grading: Echo by maximal diastolic anechoic width - small (<10 mm), moderate (10-20 mm), large (>20 mm or tamponade signs).
map.心脏压塞征象：伴低血压、颈静脉怒张、奇脉、心动过速提示填塞，属急症需引流。: Tamponade signs: Hypotension, jugular distension, pulsus paradoxus and tachycardia suggest tamponade - an emergency requiring drainage.
map.病因与随访：感染后、肿瘤、结核、甲减、自身免疫或术后积液，量随病因与流速变化，需: Etiology and follow-up: Post-infection, tumor, tuberculosis, hypothyroidism, autoimmune or post-surgical effusion; volume varies with cause and flow rate, needing dynamic recheck.
map.输入：舒张期液性暗区最大宽度 14 mm、无低血压、颈静脉不怒张、奇脉阴性、病因: Inputs: Maximal diastolic anechoic width 14 mm, no hypotension, no jugular distension, pulsus paradoxus negative, cause viral. Output: Volume Moderate (10-20 mm), Tamponade signs None, Advice Follow-up echo + treat cause, Alert Seek care immediately for hypotension / breathlessness. Note: Effusion growth rate is more dangerous than static volume.
map.积液多少算大量？: How much effusion counts as large?
map.常用超声舒张期最大液宽：<10 mm 少量、10–20 mm 中量、>20 mm: Common echo maximal diastolic width: <10 mm small, 10-20 mm moderate, >20 mm or with cardiac swing / vena cava dilation is large; but the key is tamponade signs - a small effusion growing rapidly can also be critical.
map.积液短期内增多致心包内压升高、心室充盈受限，出现低血压、颈静脉怒张、奇脉、心动过: Rapid effusion increase raises pericardial pressure and limits ventricular filling, causing hypotension, jugular distension, pulsus paradoxus and tachycardia - an emergency needing urgent pericardiocentesis; delay can cause arrest.
map.不必。少量无症状、病因明确（如病毒、甲减）多观察与治因；大量或有填塞、化脓性/结: Not necessarily. Small asymptomatic effusions with a clear cause (e.g. viral, hypothyroid) are mostly observed and cause-treated; only large or tamponade, or purulent / tuberculous ones are drained. Whether and when to intervene is evaluated by cardiology / interventional echo.
map.心包积液大小定量器，根据超声心动图测量积液深度进行定量分级，并评估心包填塞征象与: Pericardial effusion size quantifier, performing quantitative grading by echocardiographic effusion depth and assessing tamponade signs and management strategy.
map.依据国际/中国心血管指南与公开公式标准（ESC/ACC/AHA 等）逐项计算: Calculated item by item per international / Chinese cardiovascular guidelines and published formula standards (ESC/ACC/AHA, etc.)
map.实时输出风险分层、关键截断值与分级: Real-time output of risk stratification, key cutoff values and grading
map.输入数值可复核，过程透明可追溯: Input values are verifiable; the process is transparent and traceable
